newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Incumbent president Ion Iliescu, candidate of the ruling Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) meets his rival Emil Constantinescu of the opposition Democratic Convention (CDR) bloc in the last face-to-face debate on state television starting 1900 local.
State radio will also broadcast the debate.
* The electoral campaign for Sunday's presidential run-off closes at 2400 local on Thursday.
* Polling stations for Sunday's vote will open at 0600 local and close at 2100 local, said Costica Ionescu, head of the Central electoral bureau (BEC).
He said polling stations could be stay open after the deadline but not later than 2400 local.
* The accreditations for local and international observers at the November 3 parliamentary and presidential polls are valid for the presidential run-offs, Ionescu said.
* Human rights group Pro Democracy registered 3,800 observers for Sunday's run-off presidential polls, up from 3,100 who monitored the November 3 first round.

* The Romanian Foreign Ministry expressed concern over recent statements by the Russian lower chamber of parliament, Duma, saying the Dnestr region was a strategic area which requires the presence of Russian troops, spokesman Sorin Ducaru said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
